title: A fantastical journey unfolds in gorgeous Wildwood trailer
gist: Laika Studios released the full trailer for its stop-motion film Wildwood, an ambitious practical-effects production with a large voice cast, opening in theaters October 23, 2026; this is an entertainment culture piece with essentially no investable signal.

insights.claim: Laika Studios' upcoming stop-motion film Wildwood, described by director Travis Knight as the studio's most ambitious project to date, required building 136 physical sets and 231 practical puppets, indicating a large capital and labor investment in traditional stop-motion production even as digital and AI-assisted animation tools become more prevalent.
insights.speaker: Jennifer Ouellette
insights.so_what: Signals continued institutional appetite for costly practical-effects filmmaking, relevant to specialty-animation-studio economics versus lower-cost digital animation competitors, though the piece carries no direct financial disclosure.
insights.quote: We've had to build up the creative tools, the technology and our storytelling muscles to do this book justice

insights.claim: Wildwood's extended teaser, released in May 2026, drew over 90 million views ahead of the full trailer's release and the film's October 23, 2026 theatrical debut.
insights.speaker: Jennifer Ouellette
insights.so_what: An early engagement metric that could serve as a leading indicator of box-office interest, though it is not a direct financial or market data point.
insights.locator: Laika Studios released an extended teaser in May, which racked up over 90 million views
